Actual feature model: all eight are settings. Supported macOS rows require Karabiner, Linux requires evdev/uinput, and Windows requires none. No native availability certification.
Both default and recommended are 10 s; presets are 0, 1, 3, 5, 10, 30, 60. A setting does not independently activate CapsWord. The actual menu has no free-entry command.
Actual shared corpus and extended zero control; AHK uses a zero sentinel rather than Lua nil.
Corpus covers before, at and after thresholds; extended 0.5 ms and 1 ms accepted values expire at 1 ms after quantization. Controlled numeric clocks only.
CW-S001: measured Lua policy outputs, source-only AHK comparison. Handwritten configuration edge; no shipped preset affected.
1e308 seconds is accepted and converted to positive infinity. Policy-only result; native timer admission and Windows arithmetic are unexecuted. No separate confirmed finding.
Shared-model default and recommended lists agree: space, nbsp, nnbsp, tab, enter, comma, semicolon, period.

Gesture, pointer_motion, left_click, right_click, middle_click, other_buttons. Driver mapping and native event delivery remain separate.

Actual caption and required reason values are nonempty in all current 21 locale JSON files. Translation quality is not measured.

The aliases are explicitly equivalent action identities, not identical repeated-invocation semantics: Windows and Linux toggle; macOS catalogue activation sets the variable to one, while generated physical Karabiner activation is guarded when already active. Common intended re-invocation policy is not established.
toggle_capslock is declared on all OSes; caps_lock spelling differs by OS. Existing-user-lock restoration requires actual driver receipts.

Windows explicitly publishes settings for the next activation. Linux Manager stores an activation snapshot, but its real menu promises changes apply to the running session on the next event; this contradiction is being adjudicated in the Linux scope. macOS owner explicitly publishes live apply for the next event. Shared policy alone does not establish all driver timer scheduling.

Final A/B sweeps each run six processes, including both magic-key characterizations after CW-S002. No additional root was found in this bounded scope; repetitions do not add distinct coverage or certify native parity.

coverage.qualification: CW-S002: actual shared load/mutation characterization and exact menu source; public caller corroboration belongs to the macOS/Linux roles and root replay.
